summary: The legal array length is at most 100, too small for a stable scaling verdict; the single-pass structure and boundary cases replace runtime timing evidence.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The official contract limits words.length and groups.length to at most 100.

replacement_checks.evidence: After selecting the first word, the algorithm examines each remaining pair exactly once and performs only constant-time work per pair.
Authored cases cover one run, repeated runs, fully alternating groups, multiple valid outputs, and the maximum legal length of 100.
